_comment: Alert rules for the cloud watcher. NO CREDENTIALS HERE - the Telegram token comes from GitHub encrypted secrets.

rules.title: BTC LONG TRIGGER
rules.note: CHoCH confirmed. Wait for the retrace toward the 50% of the displacement leg - do not chase the close. Stop below 62268. Target = nearest pool clearing 1.0 R:R.

rules.title: BTC LONG DEAD / SHORT ON
rules.note: Sell-side BOS - continuation of the daily downtrend. Long invalidated. Short: wait for the bounce, stop above the failed high, target 57759.

rules.title: BTC SHORT CONFIRMED
rules.note: CHoCH confirmed on the close. Sweep was 64948.8 taken on 7 Aug, wick to 65358. Now wait for the retrace to ~64734 - do not chase. Stop 65403. Target 64010. R:R 1.08.

rules.title: BTC SHORT - ENTRY LEVEL REACHED
rules.note: Price traded up into the short entry. CHoCH was confirmed 10 Aug at 64017. Stop 65266. Target 62980. R:R 1.18. Entry drifts as the range compresses - re-check the level before acting.

rules.title: BTC SHORT DEAD
rules.note: Closed above the sweep wick. Short setup invalidated - the sweep failed and buyers took control.

rules.title: SUI LONG - ENTRY FILLED
rules.note: Price traded through the limit - a resting order would be FILLED at 0.6855. Stop 0.6629. Target 0.7083. R:R 1.01.

rules.title: SUI LONG - STOP HIT
rules.note: Price traded through the stop. The long is out at -1R.

rules.title: SUI LONG - TARGET HIT
rules.note: Price reached the target pool at 0.7083. The long is out at +1.01R.

rules.title: SUI LONG DEAD
rules.note: Closed below the sweep low of 7 Aug. The long is invalidated - the sweep failed. Next sell-side pools 0.6621 then 0.6503 (daily low).

rules.title: SUI 0.7000 - DECISION LEVEL
rules.note: CLOSED ABOVE = long confirmed, bear thesis dead, stop looking for shorts. (A WICK-ONLY message at this level means the opposite: buy-side sweep, SHORT setup forming - then wait for a close below a recent low, stop above the wick, targets 0.6787 / 0.6722 / 0.6676.)
